description: This file defines a Java interface 'SearchResultBuilder' which provides a fluent API for building instances of 'SearchResult'. It includes methods for setting pagination attributes, adding/removing JSON items, and constructing the final SearchResult object.

classes.name: SearchResultBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder with a fluent API for a SearchResult, allowing setting pagination, adding/removing JSON items, and building the final SearchResult instance.

methods.name: nextPageOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset for the next page of search results or a special constant indicating no further pages.

methods.name: cursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor for the next page or null if no further pages are available.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds one or more JsonValue items to the search result.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds multiple JsonValue items from an Iterable to the search result.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific JsonValue item from the search result.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an immutable SearchResult object based on the accumulated changes.
